subject: food-technology
title: Sugar, Salt & Fat
welcome_lead: Three things to watch the amount.
meta_desc: KS3 food: sugar/salt/fat limits and traffic-light labels.
final_note: Less of these means better health.

concepts.def: Sugar in foods you don't expect.
5 portions of fruit and veg daily.

walkthroughs.body_html: Adults should have no more than 30g of free sugars a day — that's only 7 teaspoons. A single can of cola has 35g. Watch hidden sugars in ketchup, cereals, sauces.
The daily limit is 6g salt for adults — about a teaspoon. Most salt comes from packaged food, not the salt shaker. Bread, cheese and crisps add up fast.
UK packaging uses traffic lights: red = high, amber = medium, green = low. Aim for mostly green and amber per portion. Compare similar products to find healthier ones.
